result.instructions: Tools for Formstack, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formstack data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run formstack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formstack_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formstack_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. formstack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formstack_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in the account, with submission counts, live URL and folder. Filter by name or folder and sort. Formstack: GET /forms.

folder.description: Only forms in this folder ID.

order_by.description: Column to order by, e.g. name, created, updated.

tools.name: formstack_get_form
tools.title: Get one form
tools.description: Fetch a form's details — name, URL, submission counts, settings — optionally with its full field list. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}.

with_fields.description: Include the form's fields in the response.

tools.name: formstack_list_form_fields
tools.title: List a form's fields
tools.description: List every field on a form — id, label, type, required flag, options and logic. Use this to learn field IDs before searching or creating submissions. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/fields.

tools.name: formstack_list_form_submissions
tools.title: List a form's submissions
tools.description: List a form's submissions, newest or oldest first, filtered by keyword, date range or specific field values. Set include_data to get the answers. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

keyword.description: Match submissions by content across all fields.

min_time.description: Only entries created on or after this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Eastern Time).

max_time.description: Only entries created on or before this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Eastern Time).

field_filters.description: Search specific fields by value (up to 10 criteria, AND-ed).

value.description: The value to search for in that field.

expand_data.description: Include expanded field data with parsed values.

pretty_name.description: Include a human-readable name per submission (from its name/email field).

data_format.description: Shape of data: legacy (object keyed by field id) or standardized (array of field objects).

encryption_password.description: Only for forms with encryption enabled: the form's encryption password, sent as the X-FS-Encryption-Password header.

tools.name: formstack_count_form_submissions
tools.title: Count a form's submissions
tools.description: Count a form's submissions, with a per-day breakdown over a lookback window of up to 7 days. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions/count.

lookback_period.description: How many days to count backwards (maximum 7).

tools.name: formstack_search_submissions
tools.title: Search submissions across all forms
tools.description: Full-text search for submissions across every form in the account, e.g. by a person's email or name. Formstack: GET /submissions.

search.description: Search term to match against submission content.

tools.name: formstack_get_submission
tools.title: Get one submission
tools.description: Fetch a single submission with every field's label, type, display value and parsed value, plus payment, approval and workflow status. Formstack: GET /submissions/{submissionId}.

encryption_password.description: Only for forms with encryption enabled: the form's encryption password, sent as the X-FS-Encryption-Password header.

tools.name: formstack_list_partial_submissions
tools.title: List a form's partial submissions
tools.description: List entries respondents started but did not finish (Save & Resume / abandoned), with the same filters as submissions. Formstack: GET /form/{formId}/partialsubmission.

min_time.description: Only entries created on or after this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Eastern Time).

max_time.description: Only entries created on or before this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Eastern Time).

field_filters.description: Search specific fields by value (up to 10 criteria, AND-ed).

value.description: The value to search for in that field.

expand_data.description: Expand data with detailed field information.

tools.name: formstack_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the account's form folders and their subfolders. Formstack: GET /folders.

tools.name: formstack_get_folder
tools.title: Get one folder
tools.description: Fetch a folder with its parent, permissions and direct subfolders. Formstack: GET /folders/{folderId}.

tools.name: formstack_list_webhooks
tools.title: List a form's webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks that push a form's submissions to external URLs, with their payload settings. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/webhooks.

tools.name: formstack_list_notification_emails
tools.title: List a form's notification emails
tools.description: List the notification emails that alert your team when a form is submitted — recipients, subject, sender and logic. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/notifications.

tools.name: formstack_list_confirmation_emails
tools.title: List a form's confirmation emails
tools.description: List the confirmation emails sent to the person who submits a form — sender, subject, message and delay. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/confirmations.

tools.name: formstack_list_submit_actions
tools.title: List a form's submit actions
tools.description: List what happens after a form is submitted — default processing, a custom message, or a redirect URL — with conditional logic. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submitactions.

tools.name: formstack_create_submission
tools.title: Create a submission
tools.description: Submit an entry to a form on someone's behalf. This is a real submission: it counts toward the form and can fire its notification emails, webhooks and integrations. Formstack: POST /forms/{formId}/submissions.

value.description: The field value as an object, shaped by field type: text/email/number/phone/textarea/datetime/radio → {"value":"..."}; name → {"first":"...","last":"..."} (also prefix, middle, initial, suffix); address → {"address","address2","city","state","zip","country"}; checkbox/select → {"subvalues":[{"subvalue":"..."}]}. Use formstack_list_form_fields for field IDs and types.

read.description: Mark the submission as read on creation.

user_agent.description: Submitter's browser user agent to record.

tools.name: formstack_update_submission
tools.title: Update a submission
tools.description: Change field values on an existing submission, or mark it read/unread. Only the fields you pass are changed. Formstack: PUT /submissions/{submissionId}.

value.description: The field value as an object, shaped by field type: text/email/number/phone/textarea/datetime/radio → {"value":"..."}; name → {"first":"...","last":"..."} (also prefix, middle, initial, suffix); address → {"address","address2","city","state","zip","country"}; checkbox/select → {"subvalues":[{"subvalue":"..."}]}. Use formstack_list_form_fields for field IDs and types.

read.description: Mark the submission read (true) or unread (false).

encryption_password.description: Only for forms with encryption enabled: the form's encryption password, sent as the X-FS-Encryption-Password header.

tools.name: formstack_create_prefill_url
tools.title: Create a prefilled form link
tools.description: Generate a link to a live form with some fields already filled in — e.g. to send a customer a form with their name and account number pre-entered. Formstack stores the prefill and returns prefilledUrl. Formstack: POST /forms/{formId}/prefill.

value.description: The field value as an object, shaped by field type: text/email/number/phone/textarea/datetime/radio → {"value":"..."}; name → {"first":"...","last":"..."} (also prefix, middle, initial, suffix); address → {"address","address2","city","state","zip","country"}; checkbox/select → {"subvalues":[{"subvalue":"..."}]}. Use formstack_list_form_fields for field IDs and types.

incomplete_password.description: Optional password protecting the prefilled entry.

tools.name: formstack_update_form
tools.title: Update a form's settings
tools.description: Rename a form, move it to a folder, change its submit-button text, timezone or language, or activate/deactivate it (with a message shown while inactive). Reversible. Formstack: PUT /forms/{formId}.

folder.description: Folder ID to move the form into.

submit_button_title.description: Submit button text on the live form.

is_active.description: Turn the live form on (true) or off (false).

disabled_message.description: Message shown while the form is inactive.

tools.name: formstack_create_folder
tools.title: Create a folder
tools.description: Create a folder for organising forms, at the root or inside a parent folder. Formstack: POST /folders.

parent.description: Parent folder ID (omit for root level).

tools.name: formstack_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Add a webhook that POSTs each new submission of a form to your URL. Formstack: POST /forms/{formId}/webhooks.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the submission data.

post_data_field_keys.description: How fields are keyed in the payload.

file_transfer_type.description: How uploaded files are delivered in the payload.

hmac_secret.description: Secret used to HMAC-sign each payload.

error_emails.description: Comma-separated emails to notify on delivery failure.

include_field_type.description: Include each field's type in the payload.

include_subfield_names.description: Include subfield names in the payload.
